newsitem.title: USA: Whirlpool mulls options for finance unit.
newsitem.headline: Whirlpool mulls options for finance unit.

text.p: Whirlpool Corp said Thursday it is exploring strategic business options for its wholly owned financial services unit, Whirlpool Financial Corp.
The analysis, which it said is part of an ongoing assessment of its worldwide businesses, includes possible alliances, partnerships and other alternatives.
Whirlpool said it expects to continue a relationship with the unit regardless of the study's outcome.

Whirlpool Financial Corp, with assets of more than $2.1 billion, provides inventory and consumer financing to the appliance, consumer electronics, lawn and garden, home heating, air conditioning and music industries.
Whirlpool Corp manufactures and markets major home appliances.
